svg.title: Bathing-Water Supply - Source Claims
svg.desc: Brochure repeats historical well/reinjection policy context and proposes single-well heat exchange for bathing-water preparation, also claiming mineral enrichment of mains water. A sealed heat exchanger heats water without transferring minerals or establishing natural mineral-water status. Any separate conditioning process requires its own specification and water-quality evidence.
